title: Ace Combat 8 lands the series' best reviews ✈️
subject: acecombat
description:
Are you flying in Ace Combat 8? 👇

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve launched October 1, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC with Metacritic scores of 86-90, the series' first cross-platform multiplayer, and Steam reviews that climbed from Mixed to Mostly Positive.

Sources: Metacritic, Tech Times, Notebookcheck
Game footage © Bandai Namco Entertainment.

scenes.text: Ace Combat 8 just landed the series' best reviews in years.
Wings of Theve launched October 1 on PS5, Xbox and PC, with Metacritic scores from 86 on PC up to 90 on Xbox.
It's also the first Ace Combat with cross-platform multiplayer, from 8-player co-op missions to 4v4 team dogfights.
But PC players weren't all happy at first, early Steam reviews were mixed, with complaints about frame drops and locked ray tracing settings.
